plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-16 by live browser from Bakersfield College's official Program Pathways Mapper (https://programmap.bakersfieldcollege.edu/, reached from the college's official program-mapper page; no login required or attempted). The map is headed 'Physical Therapist Assistant map for 2026-2027' and the pathways are for catalog year 2026-2027. Source map URL is this plan's source_url. The live browser also transcribed this program's 2025-2026 map and compared it row by row: every Bakersfield College course row is identical in the two catalog years; only term numbering/years and milestone placement differ. This plan files the 2026-2027 view. This plan transcribes the program's only pathway, 'Physical Therapist Assistant Associate of Science', in full; it is a Bakersfield College-only map with no second-institution section and no other pathway listed for this credential. The 2026-2027 map presents five substantive terms (Terms 1-5); the Getting Started and After Completion milestones are rows inside the first and last terms and carry no course content. The transcribed map prints the degree total as a range, 79-80.5 units, and term totals as 16-17.5 / 14 / 14 / 17 / 18. The only ranged row is Term 1 '1.A. English Communication (BC)' (3-4.5). Per the standing minimum-credit convention it is recorded at its printed minimum, so every term sum equals the map's printed term total at its minimum and the plan total is the printed minimum of 79 units. BIOL B32 is printed with the dual category label 'Major / Gen Ed' and is recorded with category 'major'. Term 5 prints the clinical courses in the order PHTA B81, PHTA B82, then PHTA B80; they are recorded in that printed order. Most major courses show a 'Prerequisites' flag in Card View; the map does not print the specific prerequisite courses, so no prereqs are recorded and the flags are disclosed on those course rows. BIOL B32, BIOL B33 and PHTA B50 additionally carry the separate Card View descriptor 'Prerequisite for PTA Program', disclosed on those rows; BIOL B32 and PHTA B50 show no 'Prerequisites' flag. No row shows a 'Corequisites' or 'Dual Enrollment' flag. General-education slots are transcribed exactly as printed as unselected 'Choose a course from ...' choice slots; the option lists behind those slots are not enumerated. Milestone rows printed on the map carry no course content and are not encoded. The map page states verbatim: 'This program map represents one possible pathway through the program and may not reflect the most current catalog requirements. Make an appointment to create a customized education plan that fits your needs.'
